name: taskflow
description: A production-shaped in-memory task queue whose choreographed 5-checkpoint history (T0 0.1.0 through T4 1.0.0, ~37 commits, 8 per update gap) stress-tests claim grounding and forgetting under a large, lifelike diff. Structural traps are derived from the source surface: a MemoryStore-to-InMemoryStore rename with a file move, an experimental RedisStore feature reverted a checkpoint after it ships, a TaskError-to-TaskExecutionError rename with a deprecated alias, and a same-named TaskError resurrected with a new validation meaning in a new file. Three signature-stable bug fixes (LIFO-to-FIFO dequeue, batched-to-streaming worker pool, off-by-one retry backoff) flip behavior invisibly to the surface and are reachable only as claim staleness, and a distributed-workers docstring at T4 is a code-authoritative hallucination. A transient clear() is added then reverted inside a gap.

entries.concept: package public API, entrypoint, exports, modules, release version, package metadata, and library purpose
task queue insertion, ordering, FIFO or LIFO, oldest or newest selection, priority, removal, size, and empty queue behavior
task data model, identifiers, payload, priority, lifecycle state, execution errors, validation errors, TaskError, and TaskExecutionError
worker task execution, handler behavior, queue draining, sequential or concurrent processing, worker pools, batching, streaming, running state, and failure wrapping
task result storage, Store contract, save and load behavior, in-memory storage, MemoryStore, InMemoryStore, RedisStore, persistence, and implementation availability
task retry policy, retry attempts, failure limits, timing, delays, exponential backoff, defaults, and RetryError behavior
task lifecycle events, event bus, subscribers, listeners, publication, delivery, and registration order
task scheduler, scheduling, concurrency, submitted tasks, retry options, worker processes, distributed workers, clusters, dead letter queue, and failed task burial
scheduler metrics, queued running and completed counts, monitoring, activity snapshots, and metric calculation
persistent queue, disk storage, file paths, process restarts, opening or creating queues, and durable tasks
tests, test coverage, imports used by tests, assertions, build scripts, type checking, strict mode, compiler configuration, formatting, and package commands
source files, module ownership, imports, dependencies, re-exports, file contents, declarations, and repository structure

checkpoints.label: taskflow 0.1.0 MVP: FIFO queue (latent LIFO bug), sequential worker, TaskError execution error
taskflow 0.2.0: FIFO fix, priority ordering, worker pool, MemoryStore
taskflow 0.3.0: retries, events, worker-pool fix, Store extracted with MemoryStore renamed to InMemoryStore
taskflow 0.4.0: Scheduler, DeadLetterQueue, experimental RedisStore, TaskError renamed to TaskExecutionError with alias, retry backoff fix
taskflow 1.0.0: RedisStore reverted, metrics, PersistentQueue, TaskError resurrected as a validation error, schedule retries default flip, distributed-workers doc lie
